title: Build plan: 13 Steps, 5 held MSPs, export file owned by the cleanup Step
context: The first mitosis plan-only run fused compact-log-card, day-modal, today-feed and remove-entry-card into one Lane and collapsed five MSPs into two, because compact-log-card and remove-entry-card both declared lib/features/entry_cards/entry_cards.dart and the day-modal and today-feed Steps sat between them, forming a lane cycle.
options: Accept the fused Lane: one Worker builds four large Steps serially, one pull request
Give entry_cards.dart to remove-entry-card alone; consumers import the compact card by its own path
Serialise the modal group behind the cards group so every pull request stacks
outcome: entry_cards.dart belongs to remove-entry-card alone, which also adds the compact exports there. The replan gave 13 Steps in 12 Lanes across 5 MSPs (cards, modal, screens, calendar, cleanup), parallelism 6, no cycles. The screens MSP has two producers, so its pull request targets the base branch rather than stacking; accepted because the owner reviews cards and modal first, after which its diff is clean. The run holds every MSP locally with --no-push on base/parity (cut from origin/main 128e0b4, since local main is stale at 79ad901), tiers top=claude-opus-5-5 and cheap=claude-sonnet-5, timeout 5400, concurrency 4, run directory scratchpad/mitosis/parity.
